jobs.description:
**Job ID** 19469 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Administrative **Date posted** 09/23/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence. Cedars\-Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 years in a row for providing the highest\-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We were also awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. We offer an outstanding benefits package including health care, generous time off and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News \& World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.


**What will I be doing in this role?**
  

The Program/Project Coordinator provides strategic support to a mid to large scale, recognized organizational program, leading Cedars\-Sinai system wide strategy for social drivers of health screening, partnerships, and intervention programs. You will coordinate all operations for the assigned program or project to facilitate the effective management of programs/projects according to organizational standards:


Coordinates and maintains applicable program/project schedules and agendas. This may include tracking deadlines, deliverables, composing meeting minutes and other correspondence/communication with management and/or partners.


Interfaces with other departments, staff, leaders and/or other partners in the administration of the program/project. Provide coordination of applicable logistics or information as directed by leadership.


Organizes and coordinates the development of all featured events, outreach activities, meetings and materials/collateral; in the promotion and administration of the program/project. May actively represent the program and/or the organization.


Helps foster a collaborative and positive relationship building dynamic with internal staff and external parties. May be responsible for providing any applicable education, training, on\-boarding and/or mentorship pertaining to program/project.


Supports the development and management of program/project budgets; maintain and track all supporting budget/financial files and documents. Collaborates with other departments, vendors and applicable community parties as needed.


Responsible for creating reports for management in the evaluation of the program/project performance or day\-to\-day operations. May also be responsible for documenting and tracking program/project compliance.
  

May provide feedback to management and make recommendations regarding program/project operations and/or procedures.  

  



**Qualifications**
------------------


**Requirements:**
  

* High school diploma/GED required. Bachelor's degree in health care, business administration, management or another relevant major preferred.
* A minimum of 2 years of progressively responsible administrative or strategic support experience required.
* A minimum of 3 years of organizational program or project coordination/support experience, using program/project management and development procedures preferred.
* Experience with or passion for health equity, social drivers of health, community health worker programs or community partnerships a plus.
  

  

**Why work here?**
  

Beyond outstanding employee benefits including health and dental insurance, paid vacation, and a 403(b), we take pride in hiring the best, most passionate employees. Our accomplished staff reflects the culturally and ethnically diverse community we serve. They are proof of our commitment to creating a dynamic, inclusive environment that fuels innovation.

jobs.title: Regional Program Coordinator - Southern California
jobs.description:
**Athena Coding** is an education company that provides after\-school enrichment programs in coding, STEAM, art, and other subjects for elementary and middle school students.

We are looking for a **Regional Program Coordinator** to support our Southern California programs. This is a **part\-time, hourly position** that combines remote administrative work with local travel to school sites and other locations throughout Southern California.

This is **not a fully remote position**. While much of the administrative work can be completed from home, you must live in the Los Angeles/Southern California area, have reliable transportation, and be comfortable traveling to locations including **Alhambra, Santa Ana, Rialto, and other nearby program sites as needed**.

Schedule

Approximately **20–25 hours per week**, with the potential for additional hours as our programs grow.

The schedule will vary from week to week depending on program needs. Most work takes place on weekdays, generally between **10:00 AM and 6:00 PM**.

Some weeks may involve more remote administrative work, while others may include district meetings, school visits, equipment/material deliveries, or other on\-site responsibilities.

Specific working hours will be scheduled based on operational needs. This is not a daily travel position.

Compensation

**$27–$32 per hour**, depending on experience.

**Mileage for approved work\-related travel between school sites, meetings, storage locations, and other assigned locations will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy.**

Responsibilities

* Serve as an operational point person for Athena Coding's Southern California programs
* Communicate with instructors, school\-site staff, and district partners
* Help coordinate instructor schedules, substitutions, and coverage
* Visit school sites to observe programs and address operational needs
* Attend occasional district or school meetings on Athena Coding's behalf
* Assist with onboarding and supporting instructors
* Follow up with instructors regarding training, compliance requirements, and program expectations
* Coordinate distribution and collection of curriculum materials, technology, and other program supplies
* Pick up, organize, or deliver materials from our local storage location as needed
* Help troubleshoot day\-to\-day program issues and communicate important updates to the appropriate team members
* Maintain organized records and track outstanding tasks and follow\-ups
* Assist with preparation for new program launches and transitions

We're Looking for Someone Who

* Is exceptionally organized and able to keep track of multiple programs and deadlines
* Communicates clearly and professionally by email, phone, and text
* Is dependable and comfortable taking ownership of tasks through completion
* Can work independently without constant supervision
* Is comfortable communicating with teachers, school administrators, instructors, and job applicants
* Is able to adapt when schedules or program needs change
* Has strong judgment and problem\-solving skills
* Is comfortable using Google Workspace and learning web\-based administrative platforms
* Has reliable transportation and is willing to drive throughout the Southern California region as needed
* Is comfortable occasionally transporting program materials or equipment

Experience in **education, after\-school programming, operations, staffing, recruiting, or program coordination** is preferred but not required.

Requirements

* Must reside in Southern California within reasonable driving distance of the greater Los Angeles area
* Reliable vehicle and valid driver's license
* Ability to travel to school sites and meetings as needed
* Availability during weekday business and after\-school hours
* High school diploma required; college degree or equivalent professional experience preferred

This is a great fit for someone who likes a combination of **independent administrative work and getting out into the field**, and who enjoys solving problems and keeping a geographically distributed program running smoothly.

Athena Coding is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pay: $28\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
Under the guidance and direction of the Director of IPE, the Program Coordinator supports the coordination and implementation of Interprofessional Education (IPE) learning experiences, activities, and related programming.  

  

  

This role collaborates closely with all members of the IPE support team to assist in the development, scheduling, implementation, and monitoring of IPE learning experiences and activities. The Program Coordinator helps ensure smooth delivery of IPE sessions by managing logistics, maintaining communication with stakeholders, and supporting day\-to\-day program operations across campus locations.
  

  

Based in Pomona, California, this position is primarily in\-person during the IPE academic semesters, with work focused on supporting students, faculty, and staff in IPE\-related activities. Outside of the academic semesters, the role continues with responsibilities related to IPE and broader university duties, including preparation for the upcoming academic year.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

  

* Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), video conferencing tools (e.g., Zoom), and learning management systems (e.g., Canvas or similar).
* Ability and willingness to learn new digital platforms and software tools quickly.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively and maintain positive, professional relationships with faculty, staff, students, and other stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to follow through on assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Capable of performing on\-campus duties, including walking between locations and supporting in\-person activities.
* Ability to receive constructive feedback in a positive and professional manner, and to apply it for continuous learning and professional growth.
* Demonstrate a commitment to working for an organization that values and promotes humanism.

Required Qualifications
**Education:**  

  

* High School Diploma or equivalent
  

  

**Experience or Training:**  

  

* Prior experience in an academic, healthcare, or educational setting preferred.
* Experience in customer service, administrative support, or data entry/management is desirable.
* Familiarity with coordination of events, programs, or logistics is a plus

Preferred Qualifications
Preference will be given to individuals with Bachelor’s degree, preferably in education, healthcare, communication, or a related field.

**Learning Management System (****LMS****) and** **IPE** **Content Support:**

**IPE** **Data, Participation, and Assessment Tracking:**

**Key Responsibilities**
**Meeting and Program Participation:**  

  

* Attends IPE team meetings and supports IPE program and learning experience planning discussions. May take notes, prepare materials, or contribute feedback based on student and facilitator needs.
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assists with room scheduling, supply preparation, and on\-site coordination for IPE activities held on or off campus.

**Support to** **CETL** **Units and other duties as assigned:**

jobs.title: Research Coordinator II
jobs.description:
The Department of Population and Public Health Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine at USC has an immediate opening for a bilingual (English\-Spanish) Research Coordinator II to assist in the *All of Us Research Program* funded by the National Institutes of Health. This position will report to the USC Principal Investigator.

***All of Us*** **Research Program Goals and Summary**


The *All of Us* Research Program is funded by the National Institutes of Health and part of the Precision Medicine Initiative. It seeks to build one of the largest, most diverse biomedical data resources of its kind, with information gathered from 1 million \+ participants across America. This program will be one of the most diverse health databases in history. Researchers will use the data to learn how our biology, lifestyle, and environment affect health. This may one day help them find ways to treat and prevent disease. *All of Us* is building a diverse database that can inform thousands of studies on a variety of health conditions.

**Job Responsibilities include but are not limited to**:

* Present the *All of Us* Research Program opportunity to eligible patients at Keck Medicine, LA General, and partnering clinics (in person or by phone).
* Interact with clinic staff as needed to create partnerships and increase support of the program.
* Help enroll interested participants by assisting with the consent process and survey completion through the *All of Us* research portal.
* Take physical measurements, vital signs and assist with biospecimen collection activities
* Contact potential participants to complete retention activities
* Use REDCap to document all patient contacts for both recruitment and retention


Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

**Minimum Qualifications**:

* Bachelors Degree
* Willing and able to travel to off\-site locations approximately once a week
* Strong organization, attention to detail and verbal communication


Preferred Qualifications

* Bilingual (English and Spanish)


The hourly rate range for this position is $35\.53 \- $38\.34\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Skills: Administrative or research experience. Knowledge of medical environment and terminology. Knowledge and understanding of federal, state, and institutional research regulations as well as Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and HIPPA regulations. Proficient with MS Office applications. Demonstrated effective communication and writing skills. Ability to multi\-task. Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team as well as independently. Preferred Experience: 3 years Preferred Skills: Staff education and orientation experience. Knowledge of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).

jobs.description:
Description:

Related to the Company's trucking, drayage, landbridge, and storage operations, the Account Manager Nightside is the primary point of contact for phone and email inquiries, and covers nightside Account Manager and Customer Service support outside standard business hours. This role provides responsive, accurate service to motor carriers and customers, while also assisting with billing, accounts payable (AP), and accounts receivable (AR) associated with third\-party trucking accounts. This position also covers night project drayage work, which may run from 1 to 10 days per project, and monitors the Account Manager and Customer Service email inboxes during shift hours, responding to inquiries directly or communicating any actions taken to the applicable Account Manager. The Account Manager Nightside also receives work assignments from the Senior Billing \& AP/AR Analyst and the Director of Freight Brokerage. This position is based out of the Company's Long Beach, CA office.

**Responsibilities:**

* Cover night project drayage work as assigned, which may run from 1 to 10 days per project.
* Respond to motor carrier and customer inquiries regarding gate hours, yard access, and chassis/container availability.
* Communicate locations, hours of operation, and contact information for Ports, Rail Ramps, and Depots as needed.
* Monitor the Account Manager email inbox during shift hours; respond to inquiries when able or communicate any actions taken back to the applicable Account Manager.
* Monitor the Customer Service email inbox during shift hours and respond directly to inquiries.
* Serve as the first point of contact for incoming phone calls and emails regarding storage yard operations.
* Escalate operational issues or service concerns to the appropriate Operations Manager or Director in a timely manner.
* Assist with billing, accounts payable, and accounts receivable processing associated with third\-party trucking accounts.
* Communicate the invoicing process to customers and motor carriers; track and follow up on outstanding invoices.
* Research and resolve billing discrepancies in coordination with internal finance and accounting teams.
* Assist in reconciling depot and terminal billing issues as they relate to third\-party trucking accounts.
* Maintain accurate records of invoices, payments, and account statuses using Company systems.
* Maintain and update spreadsheets and reports related to yard, billing, and carrier account activity.
* Provide weekly status reporting to management as requested.
* Receive and complete work assignments from the Senior Billing \& AP/AR Analyst and the Director of Freight Brokerage.
* All other duties and projects assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.


Requirements:  



* 3 years of experience with customer service and problem solving in trucking or similar industry.
* 1 year of experience with billing or accounts receivable preferred.
* Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experienced and comfortable with multiple computer programs.
* Organizational skills, able to meet deadlines.
* Able to communicate clearly and collaborate.
* Detail oriented and produces accurate work.

**Working Conditions:**

* Ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.
* Able to spend long periods of time at a computer station.
* Able to respond quickly to tight deadlines.
* Regularly scheduled to work an afternoon/evening shift (3:30 PM \- 12:30 AM).


NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.


**Why Join Us?**

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.


We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time\-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.


**Associate Account Manager \- West Hollywood**

  

**Introduction to the team:**

The Associate Account Manager’s primary responsibility is to develop and maintain a high\-quality portfolio of relevant, attractive, and competitive hotel and property products for Expedia Group’s fast\-growing global traveler base. The Associate Market Manager works with lodging partners within their assigned territory to help maximize the production potential in the marketplace.  



  

**Make an impact!**

The Account Management team ensures that global travelers always find the most suitable property for their dream trip and that hotel partners can reach Expedia Group’s full breadth of global traveler demand  



  

**In this role, you will:**

* Develop and sustain strong partnerships by providing relevant data insights and high\-quality needs\-based consulting services to hotel partners (e.g. revenue management advice, marketing opportunities on the Expedia Group marketplace)
* Ensure that partner hotels’ products (content, rates, and availability) are consistently optimized on Expedia Group sites to maximize customer conversion
* Secure additional lodging rates and availability information over high demand and compression periods to satisfy traveler needs
* Secure deals and promotions to support the brands’ merchandising and marketing efforts
* Continuously promote and develop hotel partners’ high engagement with Expedia Group’s full suite of:
	+ Unique market insights (partner reports, competitive data, key performance drivers)
	+ In\-house revenue management tools (Rev\+)
	+ Marketing and merchandising opportunities (dynamic promotions, packages, member deals, mobile offers)
	+ Specialized brands (e.g. Hotwire, Media Solutions) potential opportunities
	+ Self\-service tools (Expedia Partner Central)
* Execute effectively based on KPI metrics (targets, goals, and/or strategic objectives)
* Guide and support Hotel Partners to deliver the best traveler experience
* Promote self\-service
* Conduct regular self\-learning to improve skills
Travel for partner visits 0\-20% of the time  
* 

  

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* 0\-2 years of experience in account management, partner/client success, consultative sales, or related field
* Proficient in English language skills
* Passionate about travel
* Work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team
* Possess a strong appetite for innovative technology, a fast\-changing business environment, and data\-driven decision\-making
* Prioritize and multi\-task effectively to achieve critical targets, goals, and/or strategic objectives set by TPM leadership team
* Continue to follow up when facing testing situations
* Present ideas and directives clearly and persuasively, both written and verbally
* Demonstrate analytical skills with market trends, partner performance, and competitor analysis to address business and partner needs
* Proactively and consistently demonstrate the unique value proposition of partnering with Expedia Group
* Possess a growth mindset, consistently using feedback to improve in role
* Relationship builder; earns the confidence of others. Bridges and sustains solid partnerships based on mutual support through a collaborative style
Drive for results  
* 

The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in Beverly Hills is $70,000\.00 to $98,000\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $112,000\.00, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Incentive plan performance above target will also earn more than the incentive target compensation amount.\&\#xa;  

  

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.  



  

**Benefits and perks**

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life .

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Telecom
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Ads operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of advertising solutions. We partner with advertisers to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high quality sites across the web, and on millions of devices. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world\-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  

  

We’re looking for a results oriented Sales Account Manager who is passionate about partnering with our advertisers, educating them and helping to solve ambiguous business problems, mitigating risks before they become roadblocks. As a Sales Account Manager, you manage and deliver against complex advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue and achieve revenue targets. You nurture customer relationships and create revenue opportunities from the advertisers you own. You’ll not only dive deep into data to understand trends, but also communicate the “why” behind results and make actionable recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Additionally, you’ll be able to leverage Amazon’s proprietary data to provide strategic and personalized recommendations, influencing both your internal team and your external customer to facilitate them reaching their business goals. This role is highly collaborative, working with Creative, Sales, Product, and Retail partners and will drive process improvement to gain efficiency and foster collaboration. The Sales Account Manager’s strategic digital expertise and influence is considered critical to unlocking greater value and impact for our advertisers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions with revenue experience
* Develop annual brand and media strategies for growth based on overall advertiser goals/objectives
* Develop omnichannel media plans, campaign strategies, and audience targeting recommendations per brand and product line
* Evaluate KPIs and optimize campaign performance using a data driven approach
* Perform in\-depth data analysis to deliver actionable insights \& recommendations that influence short term / long term digital media strategy
* Educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and how to achieve greater results on Amazon
* Work cross\-functionally with sales and other Amazon partners to drive incremental revenue and increase advertiser satisfaction
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Experience in online marketing channels such as social media marketing, display advertising, and search engine marketing
* Experience translating technical aspects of analysis and metrics into actionable insights for the advertiser and both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Experience with problem solving and disruptive innovation, developing technology programs and working across customer organizations
* Experience in process improvement

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 4\+ years of marketing, brand advertising, media sales or online advertising work and close work with senior advertisers and agency stakeholders experience
* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Marketing, Advertising, Statistics, Engineering, or Business
* Can communicate effectively with all levels of the organization
* Experience in programmatic strategy and implementation
* Experience communicating effectively with external partners and delivering results for advertisers

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

  

USA, NY, New York \- 66,300\.00 \- 108,800\.00 USD annually

jobs.title: B2B Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Overview:
**If You’re the Best at Sales, You Have a Place with the** **Best in Pests**  

As part of the Orkin Commercial sales team, you get the advantage of a highly persuasive pitch: top\-notch service from an iconic brand name and the industry leader with almost 125 years of protecting homes and businesses. That’s backed by award\-winning training that ensures the professionalism and expertise of all Orkin Pros and the Orkin Guarantee that demonstrates our commitment to customer satisfaction.  

This role combines your competitive drive and your desire to be part of a talented team. You’ll have the opportunity to maximize your financial potential with high\-performance sales skills and contribute to the overall success of the business. And you can earn your way to an annual rewards trip honoring top performers, not to mention chart a path to leadership opportunities.  

You’ll have **more than a job**—you’ll have a **career with growth potential and benefits** that go beyond the basics. This includes a company vehicle, competitive pay and a 401(k) program. Not to mention, you’ll receive **opportunities to volunteer and give back** so that everyone has a safe place to live, work, and play. Work alongside a team that values safety, professionalism, empathy, integrity and innovation in pursuit of our mission to deliver the peace of mind only an Orkin Pro can provide.  

With Orkin’s award\-winning training program, you’ll **receive all the tools you need to succeed**. That means no industry experience required to start building your career. Plus, if there’s one thing we know at Orkin, it’s that pests keep coming back, and that makes our industry recession resistant.  

**Ready to start a career with staying power?** **Apply now!**  


Responsibilities:

As an **Outside Sales Rep**, you’ll be responsible for understanding Orkin’s products and services and how to sell them to a variety of industries. You’ll make strategic recommendations to new and existing customers to help prevent pests, uphold quality and safety, and satisfy their regulatory standards. You’ll solve problems and build trusted relationships as an essential partner protecting their business. Adept at listening to needs and clearly explaining practical solutions, you can win over customers with confidence and care.
**You will…*** Prioritize **safety** in all responsibilities
* Conduct yourself with the utmost **professionalism** and **integrity** with customers and coworkers.
* Serve as an **empathetic** problem solver for commercial customers by utilizing the in\-depth training provided to recommend the best **innovative** overall solution for each customer's needs.
* Achieve sales goals through prospecting new business and assigned leads.
* Utilizing marketing tools to drive new business development.
* Conduct an inspection of the interior and exterior of the customer’s commercial property—don’t worry, we teach you how!
* Make recommendations to customers based on your inspection and issues identified by addressing any questions, explaining the solution, and setting expectations so they have peace of mind about their pest program.
* Use the iPad we provide to prepare sales agreements and help you stay organized—we will provide training on this too!

**We Offer…*** **Estimated first\-year earnings: $60,000 \- $120,000 USD annually**
* **Base plus uncapped commission**
* **Company vehicle with gas card after training is completed**
* Company provided iPhone and iPad with sales software
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, maternity, \& life Insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match, employee stock purchase plan
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
* Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, dependent scholarship awards
* Industry leading, quality, comprehensive training program

**Why Orkin?*** You’re seeking an opportunity with career potential in a reliable, recession\-resistant industry
* You have a service\-oriented mindset that leads you to build loyalty and trust with customers
* You hold yourself responsible to commitments
* You value being part of a team
* You want to keep learning, improving and developing as a leader
* You want to join a company that supports the community
* **You want a career with a purpose at a mission\-driven company that values**
	+ *Safety*
	+ *Professionalism*
	+ *Empathy*
	+ *Integrity*
	+ *Innovation*


Qualifications:
**Minimum Requirements:*** **No Experience Required!! Sales experience preferred**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Valid driver’s license required
* Ability to obtain the appropriate pesticide license/certification if required (company paid)
* Ability to work in the field independently and interact with our great clients

**Physical Demands / Working Conditions:**
Candidates must meet physical job requirements and safely perform the job duties with or without accommodations:* Safely use a ladder within the manufacturer's weight capacity
* Occasionally lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Safely access crawl spaces, attics, confined spaces, roof tops, etc. including the ability to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
* Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) which sometimes requires an OSHA\-compliant respirator
* Willing to work in different types of weather conditions

*Orkin is an Equal Opportunity/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities Employer*

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
HiveWatch is a tech\-forward, inclusive organization fostering the evolution of the physical security industry. We are a diverse team of forward thinkers who empower each other to find creative and collaborative solutions in an industry ripe for modernization. We are passionate about the problems we’re solving for our customers and equally passionate about the company we’re building.


HiveWatch is here to help security teams pivot from chasing threats to preventing them. We protect organizations, people, and property through the intelligent orchestration of physical security programs. With better communication, more insights, and less “noise”, we are modernizing what it means for businesses and their employees to truly feel safe.

* **Funding \& Growth Momentum** HiveWatch recently closed a $33M Series B, bringing total funding to over $65 million. The company is entering "Phase 2: Scale" with multiple Fortune 500 customers secured. 95% of Americans have interacted with a product, service, or brand protected by HiveWatch.
* **Founder with Deep Industry Expertise** Ryan Schonfeld, Founder \& CEO, began his career as a police officer and investigator before leading Global Security and Safety Technology at Fox Group. He founded HiveWatch to disrupt an antiquated physical security industry with AI\-powered tools that free security operators from false alarms to focus on real threats.
* **Cutting\-Edge AI Technology** Security leaders are under tremendous pressure to modernize their function using AI, and HiveWatch is uniquely positioned to automate 90%\+ of alarm responses for organizations, transforming how enterprise security teams work.
* **Culture of Ownership \& Impact** This is an environment where you can take genuine ownership, build meaningful relationships, and deliver results quickly. If you want to help build and scale a rapidly expanding sales organization with a real path to advance your career, this is the place.
* **Direct Access** Partner directly with the VP of Sales, you'll work within a lean org structure with direct access to the Founder and senior leadership team to help shape the company's growth.
* **Relationships That Matter** Our Customers aren’t just clients \- they’re long\-term partners. We value *birthday cards over business cards* and pride ourselves on building genuine relationships that drive trust and growth.

**About the Role:**


As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you will be responsible for generating and qualifying pipeline for HiveWatch’s enterprise sales team. You will engage with physical security leaders at large organizations, introduce them to HiveWatch’s AI\-powered platform, and create high\-quality opportunities for the team.


This role is ideal for someone early in their sales career who wants exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex sales motions, and clear advancement opportunities into an Account Executive role over time.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Prospect into target enterprise accounts with 1,000\+ employees using outbound email, phone, LinkedIn and other creative outreach strategies
* Identify and engage key stakeholders including GSOC directors, physical security leaders, and risk management executives
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit, urgency, and buying potential
* Book qualified meetings and hand off opportunities to Enterprise Account Executives
* Maintain accurate CRM data and consistently track outreach, activity, and pipeline metrics
* Collaborate closely with AEs to align on account strategy and messaging
* Continuously refine messaging based on market feedback and enablement guidance

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1\+ years experience in a sales, BDR, or customer\-facing role (SaaS preferred)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort speaking with senior leaders and navigating professional conversations
* Highly organized with strong time management and follow\-through
* Interest in enterprise SaaS, AI, or security technology

**Intangibles:**

* **Coachable \& Curious:** You actively seek feedback, ask thoughtful questions, and apply what you learn quickly. You care about getting better every week, not just hitting activity numbers.
* **Gritty \& Persistent:** You **get gritty** when things don’t go your way. You don’t get discouraged by rejection and understand that consistent effort compounds over time in enterprise sales.
* **Stay in the Car Mentality:** You **stay in the car** when conversations get uncomfortable or prospects push back. Instead of bailing, you adapt your message, try again, and work the problem until you find a path forward.
* **Ownership Mindset:** You take responsibility for your pipeline, your accounts, and your development. You don’t wait to be told what to do – you experiment, iterate, and **act like you own it**.

**Additional info:**

* **Salary Range:** $70,500 to $75,000 base (anticipated total earnings $93,000 to $97,500\)\*
* Eligible to participate in HiveWatch Equity Incentive Plan.
* *Final offer will be at the company's sole discretion and determined by multiple factors, including years and depth of relevant experience and expertise, location, and other business considerations.*

 **Benefits \& Culture:**


At HiveWatch, we’re passionate about taking care of our people — and it shows in the benefits we offer. Our team enjoys:

* Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* Cutting\-edge work in an emerging field with huge growth potential
* Competitive compensation packages designed to reward top talent
* A modern, newly renovated HQ right on Main Street in El Segundo, CA
* 401(k) with a 4% company match to help you invest in your future (match launches in 2026\)
* Flexible paid time off so you can recharge when you need it

**Summary**

The Operations Coordinator supports day‑to‑day logistics and order fulfillment activities while serving as a key point of contact for customers. This role is responsible for processing B2B and B2C orders, coordinating with warehouses and 3PL partners, maintaining accurate data in ERP/WMS systems, and assisting with inventory, documentation, and billing support. The ideal candidate is detail‑oriented, customer‑focused, and eager to learn logistics operations in a fast‑paced environment. Strong communication skills, teamwork, and basic proficiency in Microsoft Office are preferred, and with Korean language skills considered a requirement.

· Coordinating operational tasks between the customer to warehouse teams.

· Documenting order data, inventory, and accounting details into systems.

· Sole key partner between customers, operations, and vendors in getting the job done.

**Typical Day**

A typical day for the Operations Coordinator begins at 8:00 a.m., reviewing incoming orders, checking inventory levels, and coordinating with the warehouse team to ensure orders are picked, packed, and shipped accurately. Throughout the day, they update order information in the ERP/WMS system, monitor shipments, and respond to customer and client inquiries via email or phone. They work closely with internal teams to resolve any order, inventory, or carrier issues, assist with shipping documentation, and support basic billing activities as needed. The day also includes tracking data, flagging discrepancies, and contributing to small process improvements before wrapping up tasks and handoffs by 5:00 p.m.

· Coordinate with operations teams such as the warehouse, and vendors

* Understand 3PL operations basics (receiving, storage, returns, parcel and pallet handling).
* Assist in resolving basic logistics or carrier\-related issues.

Customer Service \& Communication

* Serve as a point of contact for client logistics inquiries via phone and email.

* Coordinate internally with warehouse and admin teams to resolve client issues.

Order Management \& Inventory

* Enter, track, and update orders in ERP/WMS systems.
* Monitor inventory levels and assist with periodic audits.
* Notify supervisors of inventory shortages or discrepancies.

Documentation \& Compliance

* Participate in identifying small process improvements for better efficiency.

This is a hands\-on production role for an experienced producer who can independently own productions while continuing to expand their experience across larger\-scale programs.

***What Success Looks Like:***

A successful person in this role can be trusted to independently own a recurring live program while also making the producers around them more effective. They keep production details organized, anticipate what is needed next, communicate clearly, close loops, and escalate issues before they become problems.

Over time, they should be able to take on increasingly complex productions and larger areas of ownership while maintaining strong production fundamentals, attention to detail, and consistency.

***Essential Functions:*** 

**Live Event Production** 

* Independently produce assigned live events, broadcasts, recurring programs, and other live experiences from pre\-production through onsite execution and post\-production wrap.
* Serve as the primary production point of contact for assigned programs, partnering with stakeholders, content teams, technical teams, and vendors.
* Develop and maintain production plans, timelines, run of show documents, rehearsal schedules, call sheets, production schedules, and other show documentation.
* Lead production meetings, technical discussions, rehearsals, speaker preparation, tech checks, and show\-day execution for assigned programs.
* Coordinate with Technical Directors, show callers, stage managers, broadcast engineers, streaming teams, AV partners, and other production personnel.
* Manage production logistics including crew coordination, equipment needs, talent logistics, travel, credentials, production spaces, and onsite requirements.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and outstanding decisions throughout the production lifecycle.
* Build, track, and reconcile production budgets, including vendor estimates, purchase orders, invoices, and final project reconciliation.
* Ensure productions follow established brand standards, production workflows, safety requirements, rights and releases, and technical best practices.
* Participate in post\-production reviews, document learnings, and ensure project files and assets are properly archived.

**Production Coordination \& Team Support** 

* Partner with Senior Producers and Executive Producers on larger\-scale events and broadcasts, providing production management and coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
* Own defined workstreams within larger productions, taking responsibility for deliverables and follow\-through rather than providing administrative support alone.
* Build and maintain master production schedules, project trackers, action\-item lists, staffing plans, production calendars, and other project documentation.
* Coordinate project meetings, capture decisions and action items, and proactively follow up with owners to keep projects on schedule.
* Support vendor onboarding, estimates, contracts, purchase orders, invoicing, travel, credentials, crew logistics, and other production operations.
* Coordinate production assets and information across creative, technical, broadcast, event, post\-production, and stakeholder teams.
* Maintain accurate information within production management systems and ensure project documentation remains current and accessible.
* Assist producers with onsite production operations including rehearsals, backstage coordination, talent movement, technical checks, production office management, and show execution.
* Identify missing information, schedule risks, and production dependencies early and work with the appropriate producer or production lead to resolve them.
* Provide additional production support across the team's portfolio as priorities and production schedules shift.

***Required Skills \& Abilities:*** 

* Strong understanding of live event production workflows including pre\-production, technical planning, rehearsals, show execution, and post\-production wrap.
* Working knowledge of production budgets, vendor estimates, purchase orders, invoicing, budget tracking, and final reconciliation.
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with producers, technical teams, vendors, stakeholders, executives, talent, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to follow through on assignments without requiring constant oversight.
* Comfortable working onsite in live production environments and adapting quickly when schedules or production requirements change.
* Ability to identify production risks, missing information, and dependencies early and proactively drive them toward resolution.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 and Google

* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner seamlessly with the integrated creative operations team, in\-house writers, editors, motion designers, illustrators, and product marketing teams to align creative assets, gather mandates, and maintain production momentum.
* **Brand \& Asset Management:** Maintain high quality standards across all projects, ensuring produced assets adhere to brand guidelines, while managing content delivery and archiving across storage and distribution platforms (e.g., Iconik, YouTube, Brightcove).

* **5\+ years of experience** in video production coordination, broadcast, or creative agency environments.
* **On\-Site Production \& Executive Presence:** Demonstrated track record leading live shoot logistics, managing studio setups, and confidently interfacing with internal clients, external vendors, and executive\-level on\-camera talent.
* **Deep Production Expertise \& Project Management Mastery:** Comprehensive knowledge of video production ecosystems, technical timelines, and task dependencies, paired with hands\-on experience using enterprise project management platforms (e.g., Asana, Workfront, Etc). Direct Asana experience is preferred, but adaptability and mastery of project management workflows are what matter most.
* **Cross\-Functional Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to articulate project statuses, flag roadblocks, and drive alignment in cross\-functional prioritization meetings.
* **AI\-First Operational Mindset:** An early\-adopter orientation toward using modern AI tools and simple automations to streamline administrative workflows and improve operational speed.

jobs.title: Admissions & Programs Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**


We have an exciting full\-time opportunity for an **Admissions \& Program Operations Coordinator** at El Chante, our licensed 20\-bed residential substance use treatment program serving adult men in Oakland, Alameda County.


This role serves as the primary administrative liaison for all admissions into the residential Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program. This position is responsible for coordinating referrals, admissions, discharges, bed management, census reporting, and client appointment scheduling while ensuring compliance with agency, county, and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with the Clinical Program Manager, SUD Counselors, Resident Monitors, referral partners, county partners, medical and housing partners, and agency leadership, the Coordinator helps ensure seamless client movement through the program while maximizing residential capacity and supporting high\-quality service delivery. This collaboration ensures timely admissions, efficient bed management, effective communication, and a coordinated client experience from referral through discharge.


This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position working 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. The successful candidate will uphold and champion the agency's mission, vision, and values while contributing to a collaborative, inclusive, and client\-centered work environment.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Admissions/Intake Coordination:**
===================================

* Serves as the central point of contact for all referrals and admissions into the residential program.
* Receive and coordinate referrals from all approved referral sources.
* Schedule client intake appointments based on bed availability and program capacity.
* Confirm admission dates and times with referral partners.
* Coordinate client transportation and drop\-off times to El Chante, as appropriate.
* Communicate admission instructions to referral sources, clients, and family members when appropriate.
* Monitor the intake schedule to ensure efficient utilization of available beds.
* Collaborate with the Clinical Program Manager and clinical staff regarding admission priorities and clinical considerations.

**Resident Census and Discharge Management:**
=============================================

* Maintains accurate and up\-to\-date information regarding all client admissions and discharges.
* Tracks all scheduled admissions.
* Monitors anticipated discharge dates.
* Coordinates discharge information with internal staff and referral partners.
* Updates admission and discharge logs.
* Communicates changes in bed availability to appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintains accurate census information to support operational planning.

**Bed Management and Census Reporting:**
========================================

* Maintain accurate daily census information and complete required reporting related to residential capacity.
* Completing daily bed surveys.
* Maintaining the Daily Bed Day Sheet.
* Tracking occupied and available beds.
* Monitoring program census and bed utilization.
* Ensuring bed tracking documentation is accurate and submitted within required timeframes.
* Working with leadership to maximize occupancy while maintaining appropriate clinical placement.

**Client Scheduling and Administrative Coordination:**
======================================================

* Manage the daily administrative schedule for residential clients to ensure appointments are coordinated and communicated effectively.
* Coordinate and maintain schedules for:
* Court appearances.
* Medical appointments.
* Primary care visits.
* Dental appointments.
* Specialty medical appointments.
* Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT) clinic visits.
* Behavioral health appointments.
* Other approved external appointments.
* Communicates daily schedules with Resident Monitors, SUD Counselors, and the Clinical Program Manager to support transportation planning, clinical programming, and continuity of care.

### **Administrative Support Responsibilities**

* Provide timely, professional administrative support during scheduled hours, including monitoring and responding to phone calls, email, Slack, and stakeholder inquiries.
* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for El Chante, providing information to clients, referral partners, community agencies, and other stakeholders and supporting positive community relationships.
* Support admissions and census management, including responding to referrals, maintaining intake and census records, preparing admission packets, coordinating communication related to admissions, transfers, and discharges, and maintaining referral and tracking systems.
* Maintain accurate program, client, staff, and reporting records in systems including Smart Care, Clinician’s Gateway, Salesforce, Paycom, Google Drive, and other applicable databases. Generate required reports and support billing, DATAR, Medi\-Cal eligibility, service\-hour, bed\-day, and other contract reporting requirements.
* Maintain accurate and compliant client and personnel documentation, including charts, licenses, certifications, TB records, training records, staff IDs, NPI/CAQH information, and system access. Ensure documentation meets agency, contract, HIPAA, and regulatory requirements and coordinate with HR and QA as needed.
* Support staff onboarding and ongoing administrative needs, including system access, required training and certifications, Clinician’s Gateway authorizations, and training on internal systems and procedures.
* Coordinate and track facility operations, maintenance, supplies, deliveries, mail, faxes, equipment, technology, and maintenance requests to support a safe, organized, and fully operational residential environment.
* Support the therapeutic milieu by engaging appropriately with residents and assisting program staff with administrative and operational needs as appropriate.

* **Cross\-functional leadership without formal authority**. Align Channel AEs, sales leadership, extended field marketing, demand gen, and marketing ops on priorities, calendars, and measurement. Remove blockers and keep events on track.

**What you will need**

* 4\-6 years in field, channel, or demand gen marketing, owning strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution in high\-growth SaaS.

Uline, a name millions of businesses across North America know and trust, is looking for an experienced Sales Account Manager to build our growing South San Francisco, California market.

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager - Semiconductor Test Products
jobs.description:
**Your Job**
As a **Sales Account Manager \- Semiconductor Test**, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining strategic customer relationships while driving revenue growth for Smiths Interconnect's Semiconductor Test products within an assigned territory. You will serve as the primary point of contact for existing and prospective customers, identifying opportunities to expand business, delivering customer\-focused solutions, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure exceptional customer satisfaction and business results. This role supports both local and globally managed accounts and requires a strong understanding of the semiconductor test market and technical sales processes.

**Our Team**


You will be part of a dynamic commercial organization that partners closely with Sales, Field Application Engineering, Customer Service, Operations, Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams. Together, we focus on delivering value to customers, supporting profitable growth, advancing product innovation, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience in the semiconductor test industry.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with assigned customers and key decision\-makers, serving as the primary customer contact within the region.
* Develop and execute account plans that support revenue growth, customer retention, and long\-term customer satisfaction.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts and through new customer acquisition efforts.
* Conduct regular customer visits and business reviews to understand customer needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics.
* Promote and sell Smiths Interconnect Semiconductor Test products and capabilities throughout the assigned territory.
* Work closely with Field Application Engineering and Customer Service teams to ensure successful delivery of products and services while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Product Management to identify customer needs and influence new product roadmaps, development efforts, product launches, and customer adoption strategies.
* Coordinate with other Semiconductor Sales Managers to ensure a consistent, efficient, and cost\-effective response to customer requirements.
* Manage the sales pipeline, regional forecasts, and account activity within CRM systems while maintaining high\-quality customer and opportunity data.
* Prepare regional revenue forecasts and support budget planning activities.
* Develop, maintain, and report key performance indicators related to sales effectiveness, business growth, and customer satisfaction.
* Negotiate pricing, contracts, and commercial agreements in accordance with company policies and business objectives.
* Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, emerging technologies, and market conditions to identify growth opportunities.
* Develop executive\-level relationships and facilitate engagement between customer leadership and Smiths senior management.
* Resolve customer concerns and escalate issues as necessary to maintain strong customer relationships.
* Prepare and deliver presentations, business reviews, forecasts, and strategic updates to customers and leadership teams.
* Support trade shows, technical conferences, industry events, and other business development activities.
* Achieve or exceed sales growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and strategic growth objectives.

  

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Technical Studies, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of direct field sales, account management, business development, or customer\-facing commercial experience.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships and develop customer intimacy.
* Proven ability to develop, negotiate, and close complex technical sales opportunities.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated ability to absorb, understand, and communicate technical information.
* Experience managing multiple accounts, priorities, and projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.
* Ability to analyze business data and develop actionable sales strategies.
* Highly organized with strong planning and time management skills.
* Ability to travel up to 50%.

  

**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Experience in the Semiconductor Test industry.
* Strong knowledge of semiconductor test applications, technologies, and market dynamics.
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in technical or engineered product environments.
* Experience influencing product roadmaps and supporting new product development initiatives.
* Experience negotiating strategic partnerships and long\-term commercial agreements.
* Knowledge of value\-based selling methodologies.
* Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
* Strong financial acumen with experience preparing forecasts, budgets, and business cases.
* Experience supporting trade shows, technical conferences, and industry events.
* Experience in electronics, semiconductor, aerospace, defense, medical devices, or other highly technical manufacturing industries.

For this role, we anticipate paying $120,000 \- $150,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The Outside Account Management team at DoorDash partners with restaurant merchants to help them grow simply and profitable on the platform. Our mission is to support merchants throughout their journey – ensuring a positive experience while also helping them unlock meaningful growth opportunities. We work closely with merchants to understand their goals, solve operational challenges, and recommend growth strategies that fit their business – balancing thoughtful partnership with commercial impact.


**About the Role**
------------------



As a **Strategic Partner Manager II (SPM)**, you will own and grow relationships with a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, operating with a high degree of autonomy and strategic judgment. You'll lead complex, high\-impact partnerships focused on driving long\-term growth, profitability, and retention for merchants on the DoorDash platform.



In this role, you'll move beyond day\-to\-day account management to guide more strategic merchant conversations—helping partners think holistically about growth, operations, and how to scale their business with DoorDash. You'll proactively adapt account plans as opportunities and challenges emerge, identify and address risks early, and consistently drive measurable outcomes across your book of business.



Beyond your own accounts, you'll play an influential role across the team — serving as a voice of the merchant internally, shaping cross\-functional initiatives, and sharing best practices that elevate how DoorDash partners with restaurants at scale.



You'll report to a regional manager within Outside Account Management. We expect this role to be flexible, with time split between traveling to merchants and additional flexibility to work remotely from home or a DoorDash office.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Own and grow strategic partnerships:** Manage a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, consistently driving measurable growth, retention, and satisfaction
* **Lead advanced merchant strategy:** Conduct high\-impact business reviews focused on larger\-scale growth strategies, profitability, and long\-term success
* **Operate autonomously:** Proactively adjust account plans and growth strategies as merchant needs, performance, and market conditions evolve
* **Identify and mitigate risk:** Anticipate detractors, address challenges early, and implement solutions to protect merchant health and performance
* **Drive expansion and optimization:** Recommend and sell DoorDash products that support merchant growth, efficiency, and brand perception
* **Influence cross\-functionally:** Partner with Product, Operations, Sales, and other teams—driving action and outcomes without relying on manager escalation
* **Represent the merchant internally:** Surface meaningful merchant insights each quarter to inform product improvements, GTM strategy, and internal initiatives
* **Elevate the team:** Share best practices, provide feedback on decks and negotiation strategy, and support the development of Partner Managers

**We're excited about you because you have…**
---------------------------------------------


* **4\+ years of experience** in account management, customer success, or post\-sales roles with increasing scope and autonomy
* Proven track record of driving measurable growth and retention across the majority of a book of business
* Strong executive presence with the ability to command a room, influence without authority, and deliver compelling presentations
* Deep understanding of the restaurant and hospitality industry, including merchant P\&L and unit economics
* Advanced analytical skills, including maintaining complex spreadsheets and performing data analysis using tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, Tableau, or Sigma
* Strong knowledge of third\-party delivery platforms, logistics, and multi\-sided marketplaces
* Ability to synthesize data, industry trends, and merchant insights into clear, actionable recommendations
* Collaborative mindset with experience serving as a trusted partner and informal mentor within a team

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
