jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, SME & Growth
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

  

**About the team**
------------------


The SME \& Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium\-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross\-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.

**What you’ll do**
------------------


We're not just looking for someone who can hit their targets, we're looking for someone who embraces creativity and thinks outside the box. We're looking for someone who is passionate about learning and constantly seeks improvement. We're committed to providing our SDRs with the training and support they need to succeed, because we believe our SDRs are AE’s in training.


This role is based in San Francisco or New York City.


### **Responsibilities:**

* Researching and identifying potential clients across multiple industries
* Reaching out to prospects through various channels (email, phone, social media) and understanding their needs
* Presenting our innovative solutions and crafting compelling value propositions
* Qualifying opportunities and scheduling appointments for our Account Executives, teaming up with them to land accounts

---------------

jobs.title: Community Manager - Contract
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Sia is a next\-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

**About Sia Experience\-Marketing Advisory**


Sia Experience is the end\-to\-end marketing and customer experience arm of Sia. Agile and collaborative, our Marketing AdvisoryBusiness Line is recognized for delivering high\-impact, growth\-focused solutions by blending marketing, CX, creative, AI, and deep industry expertise.


As strategic partners, The Marketing Advisory team empowers clients across technology, luxury, consumer goods, finance, energy, and more to scale operational excellence and drive brand\-led growth through AI\- and data\-driven strategies. Our teams lead full\-funnel marketing transformations—from strategy and go\-to\-market execution to experience design, performance measurement, and sustainable impact.


It’s an exciting time to join us. SiaX has long been the agency behind some of the world’s biggest brands—now we’re expanding, becoming one of the most recognizable names for companies that demand bold, business\-driving creative. We’re shaping SiaX into the go\-to agency of the future. This is your chance to be part of that growth, working alongside top\-tier creatives, consultants and agency leaders to continuously evolve what a modern, full\-service agency can be. Opportunities like this don’t come around often—if you want in on the next level, this is it.

 **Job Description** **Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project\-based work.**

**Sia Title:** Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)

**Project Title:** Community Manager

**Project Length:** This is a temporary position with an expected duration through 12/31/26, may extend

**Project Hours**: 40 hours per week

**Rate:** $75\-95/hour


The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.

**Location:** Open to remote candidates

**About the Role**


This is an early\-stage community building role for a product that already has real, organic energy behind it. People are showing up, sharing what they're doing with it, and forming their own pockets of culture around it without much prompting. The opportunity here is to take that momentum and shape it into something that lasts, scales across markets, and actually feeds back into the roadmap.


You'll have the creative freedom that comes with building something new, backed by the resources of an established company.

**What You'll Do**

*Own the community strategy*

* Define what community means here: who it's for, what members get out of it, and how it grows
* Build a home for the most engaged users, one that stays well\-run as it scales rather than getting messier with growth
* Make it simple for members to run their own events and meetups, with kits that don't require your team in the room
* Work closely with social, brand, and creative teams to turn what the community creates into what the broader audience sees
* Drive adoption in new markets through community\-led outreach, adapting the approach as the product expands internationally

*Build the growth loop*

* Partner with growth on referral and invite mechanics that feel like an invitation, not a push
* Identify the creators and advocates producing the best content, and give them the support and room to keep going
* Keep real user stories flowing to marketing on an ongoing basis

*Be the connective tissue between users and the product team*

* Act as the internal voice of the community: surface themes, use cases, requests, and friction in a form Product and Engineering can act on quickly
* Own the health metrics that matter here: activity, retention, sentiment, advocate pipeline
* Make sure the path from product to community (and back again) actually works

  

**Qualifications** **What You Bring**

* Genuine, personal interest in this category. This isn't a role for someone who's community\-agnostic
* 5\+ years in community, social, developer relations, or creator programs, including at least one consumer product at real scale and one ambassador or superuser program you've built from scratch
* Experience running an online community past the point where manual moderation holds up: bots, automation, roles, escalation paths
* Strong writing with a distinct voice. You can read a room and land a joke publicly without it falling flat
* Comfort with a community that develops a mind of its own, and the ability to work with that rather than fight it
* An analytical streak. You can turn participation data and qualitative signal into something the product team can act on that week, and you know which metrics actually prove community drives growth
* A track record of building trust as a core part of the community experience, not an afterthought


Nice to have: experience designing early access or beta programs, building community internationally, or working with a product built around a character or distinct persona

**What Success Looks Like**

* A community that grows itself, where people show up for the product and stay for each other
* A named power\-user or ambassador program people actually want to join, with a clear line from it to what ships
* Early testers who reliably shape the product roadmap

Uline, a name millions of businesses across North America know and trust, is looking for an experienced Outside Sales Representative to build our growing South San Francisco, California market.

jobs.description:
**About Within**  

  

Tldr on us: **Series B, $91M raised, 7x growth** last year.


Digital Transformation gave rise to a $600B consulting Industry. AI Transformation will be 10x bigger and will be delivered through agents. We built that.


Our AI discovers how work actually happens across every team and application, Structures it into a living Context Graph, and Improves it continuously.


ServiceNow mapped 900\+ processes in 9 days. DoorDash captured 3,800\+ finance operations in 14 weeks. That's not a project. That's compounding intelligence.


OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Within to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT\-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch.


We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.


**About the Role**


This is the first dedicated business development role on our Enterprise team, and one of the first at Within. Our Account Executives currently prospect their own patches, which is the single biggest constraint on how fast we add new enterprise logos. You'll take that on: running outbound across a defined book of Enterprise AEs instead of owning a patch of your own.


Your territory: companies with $500M\+ in revenue in software, professional services, financial services, healthcare and manufacturing. Your job is coverage and speed \- finding accounts the moment they become winnable, reaching the right person first, and building net\-new pipeline across multiple patches rather than going deep on a handful of logos.


You'll have Salesforce, Hubspot, Gong, Clay, Sales Navigator, a documented ICP and sales process, and proof points that already get people to lean in. Your job is to turn that into a real outbound motion for sustained revenue growth.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain the target account list across the Enterprise segment, against a $500M\+ revenue floor. Know which accounts are live, which are parked, and why.

You use AI to sharpen prospecting, manage your time, stay organized, and prioritize your day to maximize results. Building your own Agents and Skills is a plus.

* Process executive expense reports and reconcile corporate card activity in line with company policy.

* Maintain confidential files, contracts, and records with a high degree of accuracy and discretion.

* Always comply with company policies and procedures and continually display company values.
* Actively participate in forums, training programs and education as directed by the company.
* Actively work towards achieving individual and business objectives.

* Partner with the broader operations team on office logistics, vendor coordination, and special projects as needed.

* 5\+ years' experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C\-suite or senior leadership.

* Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.
* Comfortable adopting and using AI tools to increase efficiency in daily tasks.

* Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.

* Accuracy and attention to detail, even under time pressure.

* Comfortable managing competing priorities across multiple executives without letting any one person's urgency crowd out the others.

jobs.title: Apparel & Promotional Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
A to Z Media is seeking a detail\-oriented Apparel \& Promotional Product Development Coordinator. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our merchandise department, executing and tracking product development, logistics, and vendor coordination for a diverse roster of music and brand clients.  

  

This role will focus on the seamless execution of merchandise programs, from initial start to final delivery. This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Product Development \& Timeline Tracking**  

  

\- Production Tracking \- manage the day\-to\-day product lifecycle, tracking items through the design, proofing, manufacturing, and final delivery stages  

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. For over 30 years, we have been committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high\-quality products, and competitive pricing for our global clientele. We work closely with clients to provide bespoke manufacturing solutions, including special printing, packaging, production, and logistical support. Our clients range from indie labels and branding agencies to distributors and Fortune 500 companies. At A to Z Media, we pride ourselves on being a true partner in bringing creative visions to life.  

  

Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000

jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you've been searching for!  

  

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open\-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.  

  

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:  

  

Integrity – Collaboration \- Relationships – Excellence – Creativity \- Results



Join Us,



Concentric \- "Your World Secured"


We are currently looking to hire a **Security Operations Coordinator** to join our Corporate team!


* ***This role requires candidates to be based in the Central or Eastern time zone.***


**JOB DESCRIPTION**



The Security Operations Coordinator manages client and vendor interactions to support physical security needs. The Security Operations Coordinator will maintain regular communications with client teams, advising the client's security strategy and facilitating the execution of tasks of varying scales to meet client needs. The Security Operations Coordinator will also oversee vendor relationships, providing specific instructions on the completion of a task. As the primary point of contact for both clients and vendors, the Security Operations Coordinator will be responsible for maintaining professional and efficient communications with all stakeholders.



The Security Operations Coordinator will be responsible for the oversight of all tasks, assisting the client in making intelligent and comprehensive decisions regarding their security posture.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Manage organization, client, and vendor relationships as identified and specified by the Director of Security Operations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact to oversee Concentric's suite of physical security services for all client portfolios assigned to the coordinator (15\-20 regular clients, other clients as assigned). Develop standard operating procedures and profiles for all assigned clients.
* Assess the security implications and needs of client requests, and advise appropriate security solutions given the parameters of known client preferences, history of engagement with the client, and the security environment of each task.
* Coordinate with Concentric's internal teams to ensure all functions required by clients are met. Liaise with internal teams to develop Concentric's overall strategy for each client.
* Receive client feedback directly and incorporate changes to Concentric client portfolios.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for regular and ad hoc tasks initiated by assigned clients (typically, 5\-10 tasks per week).
* Assess the feasibility of client requests given the vision, mission, and values of Concentric.
* Make informed decisions about vendor and client rates.
* Maintain responsibility for: vendor engagement, facilitation of pre\-employment screening, facilitation of onboarding paperwork, and management of vendor relationships in the long term.
* Manage staff/vendor assignments and scheduling for each task.
* Oversee GSOC response and engagement with assigned tasks and clients.
* Provide regular and timely updates to the client during the duration of tasks.
* Maintain 24/7 on\-call availability to serve as the primary point of contact for emergency response and crisis intervention/mitigation for GSOC, assigned clients, vendors, and tasks. The coordinator will also be responsible for assessing the need for senior leadership team intervention.
* Administer all administrative functions related to the oversight of past, present, and future tasks, including:
* Perform invoice review and reconciliation of all expenses related to all assigned tasks in support of Concentric's AP/AR functions.
* Manage Concentric credit card and reconciliation (in Concur) of expenses incurred by day\-to\-day tasks.
* Edit reports submitted by staff and vendors, and present to clients.
* Compose proposals and estimates for new client services.
* Travel on behalf of Concentric to represent the company in client meetings, industry conventions, and business development opportunities.
* This position requires up to 10% travel.


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Bachelor's degree in security, project management, business administration, or related degrees.
* 2\+ years working in a client\-focused work environment.
* Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Master's degree in security, project management, business administration, or related degrees.

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling’s channel ecosystem is a core revenue engine. We are hiring an **Event Marketing Manager** to own a segment for event marketing end\-to\-end: strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution.  

You will set the vision for how we activate and nurture national and regional partners, reach their HR and finance clients and prospects, design repeatable playbooks, and personally run the programs that turn partners into advocates and advocates into revenue. You will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Ops, and Corporate Events to ensure every dollar and every activation ties to measurable outcomes.**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own segment events strategy and budget end\-to\-end**. Build the annual and monthly events plan, manage the full portfolio, and reallocate spend based on ROI signals.
* **Codify repeatable segment playbooks**. Create sales activation frameworks and plays, regional toolkits, and QA checklists so programs are easy to replicate and scale with quality.
* **Execute flagship programs**. Plan and run high\-impact events and always\-on campaigns from brief to high ROI follow\-up strategies to post\-mortem, including vendor sourcing, contract negotiation, timelines and onsite excellence.
* **Own campaign and CRM operations**. Build, launch and maintain Salesforce and Outreach campaigns that attribute every touch to pipeline and revenue, with Sendoso acceleration where applicable.
* **Measure, learn, and optimize**. Define KPIs, stand up dashboards, publish retros, and use insights to shift budget towards top\-performing formats.
* **Cross\-functional leadership without formal authority**. Align Channel AEs, sales leadership, extended field marketing, demand gen, and marketing ops on priorities, calendars, and measurement. Remove blockers and keep events on track.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4\-6 years in field, channel, or demand gen marketing, owning strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution in high\-growth SaaS.
* Proven ability to build and scale repeatable partner playbooks that drive measurable pipeline and revenue.
* Financial and operational rigor, including vendor management and budget optimization
* Salesforce and ideally Outreach and Sendoso experience, with the ability to architect campaigns that drive revenue.
* Executive communication skills, strong stakeholder management, and comfort operating with high autonomy.
* Creative problem solver who ships quickly, learns fast, and continuously raises the bar.
* Work ethic that matches our pace – sleeves rolled up, high throughput, and clear prioritization.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

  

This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

  

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  

114,000 \- 143,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: Account Manager (Advertiser Success)
jobs.description:
Adflow is Fluent's commerce media advertising platform, connecting top\-tier brands with highly engaged consumers through proprietary ad inventory, first\-party data, and machine learning\-driven optimization. We're seeking an Account Manager to join our growing Advertiser Success team. In this role, you will use your performance marketing expertise, analytical, communication, and relationship\-building skills to provide superior client service, research, and market analysis for the advertisers on the Adflow platform. You will persistently explore and uncover the business needs of your clients, managing a book of business while developing comprehensive strategies that drive revenue growth and long\-term partnership success. If you're a self\-motivated and results\-driven person who thrives in a fast\-paced ad tech environment and knows how to turn data into client wins, this is the role where you'll thrive.

**What You'll Do:**

* Rapidly gain a thorough understanding of Adflow's proprietary ad inventory, machine learning\-driven optimization, reporting analysis, competitive advantages, resources, and processes, and articulate them persuasively to new and existing advertisers
* Manage a book of business and maintain strong relationships with new and existing advertisers on the Adflow platform, to successfully meet and exceed client performance expectations and ensure long\-term success
* Monitor client budgets, with a focus on growing advertising spend on Adflow inventory; prepare and present formal business reviews to top clients
* Serve as lead for all client communication, including onboarding, performance feedback, creative changes, pacing reports, performance reports, client meetings, campaign recommendations, and comprehensive strategy to enable revenue growth
* In partnership with Advertiser Success leadership, identify, create, and implement solutions grounded in measurable business results; serve as an external product consultant educating advertisers and agencies on Adflow's ad solutions and best practices, and grow the partnership
* Understand each client's key performance indicators, and clearly communicate these metrics internally for optimization
* Proactively introduce new revenue\-driving opportunities across Adflow's inventory and channels
* Manage the onboarding process for new advertisers, coordinating the flow of campaign builds with Business Development and Partner Development, creative execution with the Creative Strategy team, and tracking requirements with the Media Operations team
* Work closely with the Campaign Strategy, Media Operations, and Creative Strategy teams to provide continued feedback and analysis, optimization suggestions, and recommendations
* Formulate plans to extend new business and additional channel distribution with established accounts
* Responsible for overseeing monthly billable numbers to finance for invoicing

  

**Requirements**  

* 3\-5 years of relevant experience managing a book of business within digital performance marketing or ad tech; commerce media experience a plus
* Extremely organized and meticulous, as you will manage many advertiser campaigns simultaneously
* Exceptional communicator, comfortable presenting to advertiser and internal stakeholders
* Attentive to client budgets and spend targets, conscientious of revenue pacing, and experienced in exercising sales skills
* Excellent analytical skills
* High proficiency in Excel
* Excellent written communication skills
* Self\-motivated, self\-starter mentality

**About Us**


Fluent, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNT) is a commerce media solutions provider connecting top\-tier brands with highly engaged consumers. Leveraging diverse ad inventory, robust first\-party data, and proprietary machine learning, Fluent unlocks additional revenue streams for partners and empowers advertisers to acquire their most valuable customers at scale. Founded in 2010, Fluent uses its deep expertise in performance marketing to drive monetization and increase engagement at key touchpoints across the customer journey. For more insights visit: https://www.fluentco.com/

 **Benefits**  

Benefits


At Fluent, we like what we do, and we like who we do it with. Our team is a tight\-knit crew of go\-getters; we love to celebrate our successes! In addition, we offer a fully stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch, and our office manager keeps the calendar stocked with activity\-filled events. When we are not eating, working out, or planning parties, Fluent folks can be found participating in recreational sports leagues, networking with She Runs It, and bonding with across teams during quarterly outings to baseball games, fancy dinners, and pizza\-making classes. And we have all the practical benefits, too…

* Competitive compensation
* Ample career and professional growth opportunities
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Pre\-tax savings plans and transit/parking programs
* 401K with competitive employer match
* Volunteer and philanthropic activities throughout the year
* Educational and social events

jobs.title: Account Manager- SMB, Growth & Retention (Core)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.


We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


We’re looking for a self\-driven, growth\-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid\-remote US\-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back\-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one our fastest growing customer segments.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions\-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in\-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross\-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross\-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long\-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2\+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota\-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self\-motivated, and detail\-oriented; great follow\-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. **Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.

**About the Team:**  

The Global Agency \& Accounts (GA\&A) Team partners with the world’s largest advertisers and agencies, providing strategic solutions to help brands grow through TikTok’s suite of products.
  
  

We are looking for a data\-driven, operationally\-minded Global Account Manager (GAM) to join our GA\&A team. This role serves as the "Activator" of global initiatives—the bridge between high\-level strategy and regional execution with tracking, governance, performance management.
  
  

You will evolve the foundation by moving beyond descriptive data pulls into diagnostic and predictive analysis. You aren't just reporting what happened; you are explaining why it happened and recommending what the client should do next. This is a role for a "Quant and Qual" thinker who possesses a COO mindset: someone who loves building the infrastructure that allows global accounts to scale.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Data Diagnostics \& Strategic Storytelling
  
* Own end\-to\-end data analysis for global accounts. Move beyond basic reporting to provide diagnostic insights and prescriptive actions that drive client upside.
* Design and maintain sophisticated revenue dashboards and trackers to provide a real\-time global view of account health.
* Support global presentations by providing strategic context. While you assist in major "Top\-to\-Tops," you will fully own client presentations for selective projects, including delivery and follow\-up.


Global Infrastructure \& Execution
  
* Build and maintain the global infrastructure (Trackers, Account ID mapping, SVA/FVA allocation) that allows the team to operate with excellence.
* Act as the internal "connective tissue," aligning Product, Content, and Revenue teams to implement the global Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategy.
* Work with cross\-functional (XFN) teams to set up internal and external support systems for Joint Business Plan (JBP) delivery and tracking.


Product \& Measurement Expertise
  
* Serve as the team’s TikTok product expert. Develop an established POV through regular discovery and self\-education.
* Structure campaign testing frameworks for accurate media measurement and tracking, helping clients navigate complex full\-funnel solutions.
* Partner with regional teams to cascade product knowledge and best practices, ensuring global consistency.


Commercial Support
  
* Manage weekly and monthly revenue updates. Proactively pull insights to probe leadership on growth opportunities or potential risks.
* Identify internal opportunities to scale revenue by suggesting relevant alpha/beta product tests to regional teams.

* Ability to approach client challenges with a management consulting lens—identifying trends and translating them into product adoption roadmaps.

* Familiarity with ad verification partners (e.g., IAS, DV, MOAT) and an understanding of how TikTok solutions map to global business objectives.
* High attention to detail; you are the "first line of defense" for ensuring global standards and reporting accuracy are met.

* Experience working across different time zones and cultures with a high degree of empathy and "cultural humility."

jobs.title: Analyst, Account Management
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Analyst, Account Management
Overview  

  

Mastercard's Community Institutions team is launching Team Catalyst, an innovative new account management model designed to redefine how we partner with our longer\-tail customers.  

  

As customer expectations evolve and operational complexity increases, we are transforming from a traditional one\-to\-one account management structure to an agile, team\-based model that enables us to deliver deeper expertise, greater consistency, and broader access to Mastercard's capabilities.  

  

Team Catalyst is an incubation team focused on building the future of customer partnership and engagement. We are challenging conventional approaches, creating scalable strategies, leveraging data and automation, and finding new ways to bring the full power of Mastercard to our customers.  

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to help design, build, and scale a new model while directly influencing customer growth, experience, and operational excellence across a portfolio of Community Institution customers.  

  

If you thrive in fast\-paced environments, enjoy turning ideas into action, and are energized by solving complex problems, we'd love to meet you.  

  

The Role

You will build customer relationships, identify opportunities for growth, support business initiatives, and partner across Mastercard to address customer needs. jobs.title: Account Manager

Liminal is the intelligence platform for the people who build and buy the technology that keeps the digital economy safe. Our platform delivers AI\-powered solutions that empower customers to assess, interpret, and respond to global market shifts, critical events, and regulatory developments. We are a Series A company of about 60 people.

 **About the role**


Customers want more research, more data, and more time with our experts than we can serve today. Your job is to capture that demand.  

As an Account Manager, you own a book of existing customers and grow it. You run renewals, sell expansions, and ensure every account buys the full range of what Liminal offers: platform, field intelligence feeds, research, and events.  

This is one of a small number of commercial seats we are adding this year. You will report to the VP of Sales.

 **What you'll do**

* Own renewals and expansion for a portfolio of accounts, protecting revenue and growing every relationship year over year
* Sell into existing customers: data subscriptions, field intelligence feeds, research reprints, webinars, and event partnerships
* Follow up on and close inbound platform opportunities quickly and completely
* Grow the number of teams using Liminal inside each account: product, strategy, marketing, and sales
* Coordinate with Customer Success, Delivery, and our practice experts to bring the right people and the right intelligence to each customer
* Spot at\-risk accounts early and act with a clear plan well ahead of renewal

* Turn what works into repeatable plays the commercial team can run

**Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of account management, customer success, or sales experience in B2B SaaS, data, or research
* Renewal and expansion results you can speak to specifically
* Relentless follow\-through: you close every loop and never let an opportunity go cold
* Comfort selling to senior buyers, from analysts to executives, in enterprise accounts
* Comfortability working with the latest AI models, including connectors and MCP services
* Familiarity with at least one of our six markets: fraud prevention, financial crime compliance, trust and safety, cybersecurity, risk management, or payments
* Experience at an early\-stage company where you built process, not just followed it

**What We Offer**

* $90,000–$115,000 base salary plus commission, for on\-target earnings of $125,000–$150,000, with a performance bonus and equity

**About Norm Ai**  

Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management.

  

Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain\-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no\-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world.

  

Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI\-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products.  

  

**AI Fluency:**  

Norm Ai expects all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day\-to\-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem\-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end\-to\-end.  

  

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands\-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

**This Role**


Norm is looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to design, orchestrate, scale, and measure integrated marketing campaigns that support our business priorities and drive demand, engagement, and revenue with our target clients. As a key member of our marketing team, you'll build the campaign frameworks and cross\-channel motions that connect our content, events, digital programs, and account\-based efforts into cohesive journeys that move buyers from awareness to activation.


This role requires a sophisticated understanding of marketing with demonstrated success in integrated campaign strategy and execution across the full customer lifecycle. You'll develop and execute comprehensive campaign strategies and create compelling programs that bring to life our brand narrative and company mission.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Coordinate campaigns:** Design and lead integrated campaigns across key audiences and target clients, establishing scalable frameworks and processes that connect digital, events, content, and ABM channels into cohesive buyer journeys
* **Execute the strategy:** Create and implement campaign programs including thought leadership moments, paid programming, nurture streams, executive engagement programs, and ABM activations.
* **Drive cross\-functional collaboration:** Collaborate with stakeholders across Marketing, GTM, and Norm Law to ensure campaigns align with company\-wide strategy while meeting client\- and narrative\-specific needs
* **Maintain the message:** Coordinate across Marketing to ensure consistent messaging and positioning across all campaign touchpoints
* **Drive project management:** Manage campaign resources including agency partners, vendors, and internal creative and content stakeholders to deliver programs on time and on budget
* **Own the metrics:** Drive continuous improvement through post\-campaign analysis, stakeholder feedback, and data\-driven optimization

**What We’re Looking For**

**Core Qualifications**

* 3\-5\+ years of experience in demand generation, integrated marketing, or campaigns.
* Have a track record of successfully building and scaling integrated campaign programs that span digital, events, content, and ABM channels
* Have strong analytical skills and a data\-driven approach to campaign optimization and attribution
* Have strong project management skills with experience managing complex, multi\-channel campaigns simultaneously
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast\-paced, evolving environments with a bias for thoughtful action
* Creative and strategic thinking, you can turn a vague idea or goal into a concrete, compelling plan and see it through to execution

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with AI, legal technology, regulation and policy, or another complex enterprise category
* Scaled integrated marketing programs across channels
* Expertise in 2\-3 marketing channels (paid, webinars, content, etc.) with a passion to excel in new ones (AEO, social, etc.)

**What Success Looks Like**

**30 Days**

* Develop a strong understanding of Norm’s GTM model, business priorities, audiences, and existing campaign commitments.
* Build relationships with key internal stakeholders and assess current partners, processes, and capabilities.

**60 Days**

* Present a prioritized integrated campaign plan, including what channels to invest in, areas for optimization, and what to deprioritize
* Define initial concepts, target audiences, channel tactics, budgets, and success measures for priority programs.

**90 Days**

* Establish a clear roadmap for Norm’s integrated campaigns
* Move the first priority program into execution with aligned stakeholders, ownership, timelines, and measurement.

**Compensation and Benefits**

**Range:** $120K \- $160K

Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**


Darkroom owns creator strategy for the brands we work with, and more of them now want a community behind it: creators, customers, and fans who post because they want to, not because a brief told them to. This role builds those communities from zero and runs them as a growth channel.


A community here is measured on what it produces outside itself: posts, content, referrals, and signups or sales. Most of our communities are tiered. A small inner circle of top creators gets money, early access, and a direct line to the brand. A larger ambassador tier gets access, perks, and first look at launches. Program tiers, like campus leaders or customer champions, run their own threads. And the open community is where everyone else joins. You decide how people get in, what each tier gets, what happens every week, and how activity turns into output.


This is a consumer role. The people in these communities are students, parents, professionals, and fans, and a community run like a support forum or a developer channel will not work here.


You report to a Director and work alongside the creator leads, the social team, paid media, and each client's product and brand teams.


This role is based in New York, working US hours, with travel for events.

**What You'll Do**


Build new communities

* Choose the platform for each community (usually Discord, sometimes Slack, WhatsApp, Geneva, Circle, or a subreddit) and stand it up: channel architecture, roles and permissions, bots, onboarding, tier assignment, and moderation rules.
* Set the entry rules and the offer for each tier with the creator leads and the client, such as free product for creators over a follower threshold, student access, or referral perks.
* Build a proof channel before launch, where members show what the product did for them. It is the flex wall, and the best posts get reposted by the brand.


Run it every week

* Welcome new members, assign tiers, and post open briefs in \#briefs with a clear view of who claimed what and when it is due.
* Run the 1\-in\-20 triage: find the post that popped, work out why, and brief the rest of the roster on it the same week.
* Repost the top receipts and hand the best ones to the social and paid teams.
* Give members a real line to the brand. Route product questions, feedback, and bug reports to the client's team and bring the answers back.
* Monthly: an AMA with someone from the brand, program leaderboards, and a roster health check (who is posting, who has gone quiet, and what you do about it).


Launches and drops

* Every launch lands in the community first. You run the sequence: inner circle, then ambassadors and program tiers, then everyone else, in step with the social team.
* Get real conversation going in the first two hours. No copy\-paste.


In person

* Co\-run creator events with the creator leads, such as pre\-launch dinners, launch parties, and campus or pop\-up activations. Recruit into the community on the spot, and make sure every event produces content.


Measure it

* Report on each community as a growth channel: members by tier, weekly active share, proof posts per week, the share of ambassadors posting, and signups or sales attributed through community links and codes.
* Write the SOPs as you go, so each program scales, transfers, and makes the next build faster.

**What Good Looks Like at 90 Days**

* At least one community is live with tiers, onboarding, and moderation, ahead of a client launch.
* The client's creator roster is in it, and the proof channel has a steady flow of posts from real use.
* The weekly cadence runs through the Creator Associates. You are not the one moderating.
* Community activity is tied to signups or sales in a view the client can read.
* There is a written playbook the next community can start from.

**What We're Looking For**

* You have built and run an online community for a consumer product, ideally one that grew fast. This is the most important thing on this list. Running a Discord at thousands of members is a strong signal. Moderating someone else's community is not the same thing.
* You know what makes people post. You can say why one post gets reshared and another does not, and turn that into a brief other people can use.
* Fluent in creator culture across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X, and comfortable with everyone from a college sophomore to a creator with a million followers.
* Technical enough to own the setup yourself: roles, permissions, bots, onboarding f

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**About HungryPanda**

Founded in 2017, HungryPanda is a leading Asian food delivery platform worldwide. Guided by its core value of “Satisfy Your Chinese Taste”, the company connects overseas Chinese communities with authentic Chinese cuisine through technology and services, while empowering the globalization of the Chinese catering industry.

Starting from Nottingham, the UK, HungryPanda has expanded its business to more than 80 cities across 10 countries, including the United Kingdom, France, Italy, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea and Singapore.

At present, HungryPanda partners with over 260,000 riders and 140,000 merchants, serving more than 10 million users globally. The company has completed its Series D\+ financing, with a total financing amount of over US$275 million.

**关于熊猫外卖**

熊猫外卖成立于 2017 年，是目前全球规模领先的海外亚洲美食外卖平台。公司以 “满足你的中国胃” 为初心，用科技与服务连接海外华人与中华美食，助力中餐产业全球化发展。

企业从英国诺丁汉起步，业务现已覆盖英国、法国、意大利、美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、新西兰、日本、韩国、新加坡 10 个国家、80 多座城市。目前，熊猫外卖合作骑手超 26 万名，合作商户超 14 万家，全球服务用户超 1000 万人，并已完成 D \+ 轮融资，累计融资金额超过 2\.75 亿美元。

**Our Value**

HungryPanda’s vision is to become the global market\-leading platform that enables overseas Chinese business in the food industry and connects Chinese food to all consumers who enjoy it.

**我们的价值观**

成为全球市场领先的在线餐饮生活平台，赋能海外中餐产业，搭建中餐爱好者与中华美食的桥梁。

**Our Mission**

Connecting merchants to consumers via our state\-of\-the\-art online platform and industry\-leading delivery service. Consolidating the end\-to\-end value chain of the overseas Chinese food industry to leverage efficiency and scale. Creating business opportunities via our far\-reaching business network and digital solution

**我们的目标**

通过不断优化的线上平台和行业领先的配送服务将餐厅和每一位顾客连接；不断巩固海外中餐行业的端对端价值链；不断努力提高效率和扩大规模，将中华美食传递到世界的每一个角落

**Our People**

Above all we are food lovers, curious to explore new opportunities, as passionate about creating value for every stakeholder in our ecosystem as we are about delivering our customers quality authentic oriental food. We are a young company, innovative and enthusiastic, creative and professional, supporting our team members to work efficiently rather than long hours. We value everyone’s opinion and encourage open\-mindedness and sharing within the team. We work hard, play hard, and – of course – keep our workforce fed and happy!

**我们的团队**

我们是一群美食爱好者，我们渴望探索新的机遇，并热衷于为我们的生态系统中的每个人创造价值，就像我们要为客户提供优质正宗的中华美食一样。我们是一家年轻，创新，热情，和专业的公司，我们注重效率也拥抱革新。成功绝非只靠一个人的努力，团队意识是我们秉持的企业奥义，我们尊重彼此、乐于聆听、共同分享。每一份努力都将创造价值，我们用心工作，但也不忘尽情玩乐。

**加入我们，一起将中国美食推向全球！Join us，\***now**\*！**

jobs.title: Client Success Manager, Fortune Live Media
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

The Client Success Manager will have the responsibility for delivering a successful client experience for the Fortune Conferences division, both live and virtual. This position requires delivering against contracted benefits and event objectives, working as a sales representative proxy along with supporting the seller's pre\-sale efforts. The successful candidate will be a strong client relationship builder and will be able to navigate internal teams (production, programming, marketing, edit, sales) to ensure optimal results for clients. This position must be able to communicate clearly with clients, ensuring their expectations are exceeded. Reports directly to the VP, Events \& Executive Experience.  



**Primary Responsibilities**

You will assume responsibility for the client experience upon confirmation of the sponsorship sale through to onsite execution and post\-event wrap up for both new and existing clients as they renew partnerships.  



In your role, you are representing sales as you work with clients, and you are the primary liaison between the sponsor and the internal programming, production, editorial, and marketing teams.  



* **Pre\-Sale**
	+ Partner with the VP of Global Conference Partnerships to communicate conference offerings, sponsorship opportunities, and available inventory to the broader Sales team.
	+ Collaborate with Sales to develop customized sponsorship proposals that align with client objectives, conference strategy, and available opportunities.
	+ Maintain and manage sponsorship inventory, ensuring accurate availability, allocation, and visibility into conference offerings.
	+ Work cross\-functionally with Programming, Editorial, Marketing, Production, and other internal teams to assess the feasibility and execution requirements of proposed sponsorship opportunities.
	+ Support proposal development, revisions, and client requests, ensuring all proposed sponsorship benefits are compelling, accurate, and operationally achievable.
* **Post Sale \- Pre\-conference**
	+ Ensure all client contract benefits are successfully delivered, working with client, your sales representative and the conference production internal teams to fulfill benefits properly and on time
	+ Ability to think strategically, grasping client key messages and priorities, enabling tailored and effective support
	+ Maintaining a clear and consistent dialogue with the sales representative to make sure the communication with clients meets their expectations
	+ Handle event registrations and communications with client executives and non\-executives
	+ Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders
	+ Provide exceptional customer service by addressing client inquiries and their concerns in a timeline manner
	+ Coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful delivery of client benefits and expectations
	+ Develop/enhance and execute custom activation as outlined in contract
	+ Provide internal updates via weekly status report
* **Post Sale \- On\-site**
	+ Dedicated onsite point person for client executives, ensuring all expectations are met
	+ Communicate on behalf of client executives, as needed
	+ Assist with client executives’ scheduling, including booking meetings
	+ Manage all client\-related on\-site programs and deliverables
	+ Manage on\-site client relations
	+ Ensure client executives’ experiences as speakers and/or participants are positive
	+ Support overall Fortune Conferences sales team onsite as needed
* **Post Sale \- Post\-conference**
	+ Conduct post event reviews with client and sales
	+ Support the sales team by identifying opportunities for renewing or upselling additional services to enhance client experiences
	Work with sales and go\-to\-mraket team on post event recap materials post for all tent\-pole events  
	+

**Professional/Personal Qualifications**

* 6\+ years of experience in corporate sponsorship management in a live/virtual event setting
* Ability to travel domestically and globally
* Creative mind\-set with exceptional attention to detail and great organizational and time management skills
* Excellent client services experience – comfortable interacting with high\-level executives
* Strong communications and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with clients and work collaboratively across functions and departments
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities  
* 

**Location:** NYC \- Hybrid. Successful candidates must live a commutable distance from our Lower Manhattan headquarters for a minimum of 4 days a week.  



  

**Salary:** $90,000\-$100,000 base, plus eligibility for a variable annual bonus.This range is a good faith estimate and may ultimately vary based on a number of relevant factors.  



  

**A Few of Fortune’s Perks \& Benefits**

* 20 vacation days and 2 personal days on top of 11 company holidays and an honor\-based sick leave policy
* Health, dental, and vision coverage (90% paid for individuals and families), along with flexible spending accounts where Fortune contributes to your HSA
* 401(k) plan
* Generous parental leave
* Dependent care, commuter, and cell phone benefits
* Tuition reimbursement program

A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture  

* 

  

**About Fortune**

  

At Fortune Media, our mission is to change the world by making business better. We achieve that by providing trusted information, great storytelling, rigorous benchmarking and world\-class community building. And our key values are humility, ownership, and transparency.  



  

The policy of Fortune Media is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Sales Representative II
jobs.description:
**About NYC Health \+ Hospitals**
---------------------------------

  

MetroPlus**Health** provides the highest quality healthcare services to residents of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island through a comprehensive list of products, including, but not limited to, New York State Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare, Child Health Plus, Exchange, Partnership in Care, MetroPlus Gold, Essential Plan, etc. As a wholly\-owned subsidiary of NYC Health \+ Hospitals, the largest public health system in the United States, MetroPlus**Health**'s network includes over 27,000 primary care providers, specialists and participating clinics. For more than 40 years, MetroPlus**Health** has been committed to building strong relationships with its members and providers.


Purpose of Position:


Under supervision, identifies qualified participants and educates them as to the benefits of selecting MetroPlus as a managed care provider. Achieves predetermined monthly enrollments based on regularly updated goals and objectives. May provide training of and/or supervision to subordinate staff and maintains a positive public relations presence within the community.


**Work Shifts**
---------------

  

**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**  

  

  



**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------

  

Level I


* Implement methods, activities and action plans necessary to achieve daily, weekly and monthly objectives.


* Presents clear and accurate information regarding health plan to eligible recipients and community\-at\-large.


* Performs group and individual presentations for purpose of educating and enrolling qualified participants in a variety of arenas included but not limited to income support centers, provider sites, churches, WIC programs and shelters.


* Presents MetroPlusHealth Plan information to HHC employees at annually designated open enrollment periods.


* Performs telemarketing activities as appropriate for purposes of enrollment and follow\-up activity.


* Maintains accurate documentation related to enrollment and field activities.


* Participates in regularly scheduled sales/marketing meetings as required.


* Performs other related tasks as directed.


Level II


* May act as a preceptor to subordinate enrollment sales representative assistants or enrollment sales representatives to facilitate their understanding of MetroPlus objectives, operations and site specific information.


* Implements and monitors appropriate methods, activities and action plans necessary to regularly achieve accelerated predetermined enrollment objectives.


* Ensures appropriate and accurate documentation of plan enrollments and field activities.


* Provides assistance and facilities communications to sales management team.


* Participates in bi\-weekly and monthly sales/marketing meetings.


* Performs related duties.


* Performs all duties of enrollment sales representative level I.


**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  

1\. Satisfactory completion of three months of training and orientation administered by MHP personnel; or,
  

2\. High School graduation or evidence of having satisfactorily passed a High School
  

Equivalency Program; and,
  

3\. Demonstrated skills in written and or oral communication; and,
  

4\. Minimum one year of experience in direct consumer contact, sales and/or social services; or,
  

5\. A satisfactory equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  

6\. Knowledge of a second language may be required.
  

  

Special Notes:
  

1\. For placement in Assignment Level II, candidates must possess one (1\) year of experience in Assignment Level I or an additional year of related full\-time experience.
  

2\. For placement in Assignment Level III, candidates must possess one (1\) year of experience in Assignment Level II or an additional two (2\) years of related full\-time experience, with at least one (1\) of those years in a supervisory capacity.


**Benefits**
------------

  

NYC Health and Hospitals offers a competitive benefits package that includes:


* Comprehensive Health Benefits for employees hired to work 20\+ hrs. per week
* Retirement Savings and Pension Plans
* Paid Holidays and Vacation in accordance with employees' Collectively bargained contracts
* Loan Forgiveness Programs for eligible employees
* College tuition discounts and professional development opportunities
* College Savings Program
* Union Benefits for eligible titles
* Multiple employee discounts programs
* Commuter Benefits Programs

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About the Team**


Dow Jones Risk Sales is a dynamic, global organization focused on helping businesses make smarter decisions through trusted news, data, insights, and information solutions. Our teams partner with organizations across industries to understand their unique challenges and connect them with the Dow Jones products and services that drive growth, manage risk, and support informed decision\-making.


**About the Role**


The Sales Development Representative is responsible for identifying, contacting, and qualifying new leads in order to set\-up introductory meetings with members of the Americas Strategic sales team.


**You Will:**


* Call current and prospective clients to set\-up meetings for our Professional Information Business suite of products.
* Work closely with Sales Directors, Account Executives and Sales Specialists to devise sales campaigns for specific segments. Identify target groups, build prospect lists and generate qualified sales leads through targeted campaigns.
* Identify, qualify and develop new leads to achieve and exceed personal and team revenue goals.
* Develop necessary internal relationships with all parts of the Professional Information Business team (Data Strategy, Product, Marketing \& Sales).
* Maintain records of sales calls, contacts and sales campaigns in the global CRM to provide timely management information.

**You Have:**


* 1\+ year experience required
* Comfort and confidence with cold calling.
* Ability to work in a team environment.
* Proactive mindset, with a 'can do' attitude and the ability to adapt in a fast changing environment.
* Good planning and organizational skills.
